description.zh: API编号，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the API. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.
The Alibaba Cloud account of the app owner.

description.zh: API分组ID，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

description.zh: 指定要查询的页码，默认是1，起始是1
description.en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时每页行数，最大值100，默认值为10
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
指定要操作API的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **PRE**: 预发
- **TEST**: 测试
description.en:
The environment. Valid values:

- **RELEASE**: the production environment

- **PRE**: the staging environment

- **TEST**: the test environment

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向API提供者
- 查询结果返回的所有应用（app）均可访问指定的API
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API providers.

- All applications included in the responses have access to the specified API.
